_comment: box_diffusive.json with a VOID channel: the same 50x50 box of ten mean free paths per cell at a scattering ratio of 0.99, with a Sigma_t = 0 channel six cells high (y in [2.2, 2.8]) running in from the left face to x = 3.5, so it neither cuts the box in two nor reaches the right face. The problem the DSA's void masking is pinned on: -precon_dsa used to refuse any Sigma_t <= 0 cell; now the void cells are masked out of the diffusion correction (identity rows, nothing restricted or corrected there) and a face into the void is a Marshak face for the diffusive cell beside it.
